verdict.rationale: Evidence shows multi-user pricing tiers ('Unlimited users', 'Remote access') and an MCP server that acts 'on behalf of a Superset user' (singular, likely the calling agent's own account), but there is no documentation of an engineering-lead or admin role creating/launching agent sessions for other specific teammates across an org. No RBAC, delegation, or org-admin session-provisioning workflow is evidenced.
